title: Membrane Solutions Outdoor Water Filter — Ultrafiltration, up to 5000 Litres, 100 g
short_description: Compact outdoor water filter by Membrane Solutions with ultrafiltration, carrying strap and only 100 g weight — for camping and hiking.
long_description: The Membrane Solutions outdoor water filter (model UF, manufacturer part number S1) is rated for a capacity of up to 5000 litres according to Amazon and uses ultrafiltration. The filter accuracy is stated as up to 0.1 micron. It needs no electricity, the maximum flow rate is 500 ml per minute according to Amazon and the maximum TDS level is 500 ppm. It measures 43 x 43 x 188 mm and weighs 100 g. According to Amazon the box contains the water filter, a carrying strap and a manual. Before buying, please read the manufacturer's information on water treatment and use on the Amazon product page carefully.
features: Capacity up to 5000 litres (according to Amazon)

buying_angle: Handy for campers and hikers looking for a lightweight, non-electric filter for the trail who want to check the manufacturer's details before buying.
